title: Resident Evil 2/Weapons
text:
Combat Knife
 Game description: "A combat knife it could come in handy..."
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon and Claire (all versions)
 Ammo type: N/A
 Capacity: N/A
 Power: Very low
 Best used against: Crows, miniature spiders, zombies, and Cerberus (while they're on the ground)
 Found in: From game start
Handgun
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon, Ada and Claire (all versions) 
 Ammo type:Handgun Bullets
 Capacity:18 rounds(Leon),13 rounds(Claire and Ada)
 Power:Medium
 Best used against: Zombies, Cereberus and Crows. The upgraded handgun for Leon is also effective against Lickers and Plants
 Found in: From game start
 Upgrades: For Leon an upgrade can be found that allows the handgun to fire three-round bursts
Bowgun
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon:Claire (all versions) 
 Ammo type: Bowgun Bolts
 Capacity:18 rounds
 Power:Very good
 Best used against: Zombies, Lickers and Spiders
 Found in: Gun shop owners corpse and cabin
 Upgrades: N/A
Shotgun
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon(all versions)
 Ammo type: Shotgun Shells
 Capacity: 5 Shells(basic) 7 Shells (Upgrades)
 Power: High
 Best used against:Zombies, Lickers, Plants and Spiders
 Found in: Gun shop owners corpse and S.T.A.R.S. Office
 Upgrades: Extra barrel and foregrip, making shotgun more powerful
Magnum
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon (All Versions)
 Ammo type: Magnum Rounds
 Capacity: 8 Rounds
 Power: Very High
 Best used against: William, Lickers, Plants and Offspring
 Found in: Room near stairs to underground
 Upgrades: Extra long barrel, making the Magnum even more powerful
Spark Shot
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Claire (All Versions)
 Ammo type: N/A
 Capacity: 100%
 Power: Medium
 Best used against: Zombies, Dogs and William
 Found in: Near Dead Body in Factory Corridors
 Upgrades: N/A

Sub-machine gun
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon and Claire (All Versions)
 Ammo type: SMG bullets
 Capacity: 100%
 Power: (per round) Medium
 Best used against: Lickers, William, Plants and Offspring
 Found in: Armory in Basement and Fingerprint room in Umbrella Lab
 Upgrades: N/A
Flamethrower
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Leon (All Versions)
 Ammo type: N/A
 Capacity: 100%
 Power: Medium
 Best used against: Plants and Giant Moth
 Found in: Umbrella Lab rest area
 Upgrades: N/A
Grenade Launcher
 Game description:N/A
 Characters who receive this weapon: Claire (All Versions)
 Ammo type: Explosive, Flame and Acid
 Capacity:240
 Power: High to Very High
 Best used against: All Enemies (Depending on type of ammunition used)
 Found in: S.T.A.R.S. Office
 Upgrades: N/A
